description: AI hero image for an EXISTING article, attached as its featured image; the body is untouched (for a new article use generate_content with generate_images). Async (~20-60s): poll get_content until Featured Image shows a new URL. Costs one image credit and one AI-image unit of the site budget. Refuses if a hero exists unless replace is true, which overwrites it.

replace.description: Overwrite an existing hero image (default false). Leave off in pipelines so a hand-picked image is never replaced silently.

name: generate_hero_image
